descriptionBody:
The Role

The Account Director is responsible for overseeing one or more customers and teams, ensuring the delivery of honest, reliable services with transparency and clarity. They act as a strategic partner, offering innovative solutions when technology alone may not meet a customer’s goals. Collaborating closely with internal teams, the Account Director plays a key role in driving both customer and employee success. Through proactive leadership, clear communication, and a commitment to excellence, they foster strong relationships that support long-term growth and satisfaction for all stakeholders.
 
This role is expected to be office based at least 2-3 days a week.

descriptionBody:
The Role

We are hiring an Account Manager for LearnGxP to drive the growth of Veeva’s accredited GxP eLearning library in the life sciences industry. In this role, you’ll drive your own success by generating sales demand and pipeline revenue through outbound lead development. You will own the end-to-end sales process, including generating leads, qualifying opportunities, closing deals, and collaborating with Veeva account executives. 
 
You will also act as a strategic partner and cultivate strong customer relationships by shaping market messaging, providing thought leadership, and facilitating customer adoption of the Veeva LearnGxP offering to promote long-term success. Leveraging your expertise in sales, life sciences, and online learning, you’ll develop innovative solutions to meet customer needs and promote rapid growth in digital training.
